prompts.title: Q: Is using Shodan OSINT?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Querying** **Shodan** is **using** a **third-party** **database** of **banners**-often treated as **passive** **intel** **collection**, but **confirm** **contract** and **local** **law**; some clients require **no** **third-party** **paid** intel.

prompts.title: Q: Employee LinkedIn—fair game?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**Reality:** **Public** **profiles** are **public**, but **mass** **harvesting** **PII** may violate **policy** or **privacy** **law**. **Use** **minimum** necessary for **tech** **stack** or **org** **chart** **context**.
